_note: The zip-route gate's mapping (workplan 0116 T10, second half). A THIRD mapping beside the archive-import one: the same five-file Takeout, but as the two-part .zip download in test/e2e/fixtures/takeout-zip, pointed at part 1 so the reader has to find part 2 on its own. Its target is a SUBFOLDER of the same e2e-target account (e2e.yml appends from-zip/ to the URL; the gate creates the collection first), so the import writes into an empty folder rather than adopting what the folder route already put at the root — and the two routes can then be compared file for file. Loads PAUSED like every mapping; green-lit only by its own gate, which runs after the archive-import gate. e2e.yml writes it under a name that sorts after both other mappings; the gates select by id, never by position.
